notes: Offline evaluation rubric only; never send this answer key to the agents. Recommendations are fixture-author expectations, not actual LLM outputs or official Ryde policy. Null refund means undetermined. All monetary values are SGD.

cases.scenario: Valid charge despite lower driver rating
cases.reason: Arrival, timer and stationary pickup records establish the full eight-minute wait. Prior ratings do not disprove the trip records.
acceptance_criteria: Uphold SGD 5 as driver compensation.
Do not treat low driver rating or a historical flag as proof of current fault.

cases.reason: Only four minutes elapsed; neither the free-wait period nor the no-show threshold was met.
acceptance_criteria: Reverse the SGD 5 charge.
Distinguish four elapsed minutes from both policy thresholds.

cases.scenario: Driver waits at the wrong location
cases.reason: All supplied driver locations are at the drop-off, not the booked pickup. Waiting there does not establish a pickup no-show.
acceptance_criteria: Reverse SGD 5.
Compare coordinates, not just the driver's Arrived status.
assumptions: No-show waiting must take place at the booked pickup; the sample policy does not explicitly define a geofence radius.

cases.scenario: Early arrival with undefined wait-start policy
cases.reason: The wait is eight minutes from arrival but six from scheduled pickup. Supplied policy does not define whether early arrival counts.
acceptance_criteria: Identify the eight-versus-six-minute ambiguity.
Request an authoritative wait-start rule; do not guess a refund amount.

cases.reason: The no-show conditions are met, but the actual fee exceeds the policy fee by SGD 5.
acceptance_criteria: Refund SGD 5 and retain SGD 5 for driver compensation.
Do not refund the full SGD 10 or uphold the excess.

cases.scenario: Missing evidence of arrival and waiting
cases.reason: Trip summary timestamps and a charge record alone cannot independently verify arrival or waiting location.
acceptance_criteria: Identify missing GPS, arrival/timer events and contact records.
Do not infer the driver was absent solely because records are missing.

cases.scenario: Trip summary and app timer disagree
cases.reason: Trip summary implies eight minutes; the app timer implies six. The policy does not resolve which clock controls.
acceptance_criteria: Report the two-minute clock discrepancy.
Do not hide the conflict behind the fee-applied event.

cases.scenario: Rider replies but cannot reach pickup
cases.reason: The rider acknowledges being away. A reply is not boarding or an extension agreed by the driver; the eight-minute wait is documented.
acceptance_criteria: Uphold SGD 5.
Do not confuse replying to a message with showing up or a granted extension.
assumptions: There is no additional agreed extension or policy exemption in this record.

cases.reason: Driver message and moving GPS records contradict continuous presence at pickup. Delayed cancellation does not establish eight minutes of waiting there.
acceptance_criteria: Reverse SGD 5.
Check location through the wait, not just elapsed time between arrival and cancellation.
assumptions: The no-show threshold requires waiting at the pickup; this is implicit in the sample scenario rather than explicitly stated in the four-field policy.

cases.scenario: One second short of no-show threshold
cases.reason: Only 479 seconds elapsed against an eight-minute (480-second) no-show threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Reverse SGD 5 under the benchmark's exact-threshold interpretation.
Do not round 7:59 up to 8:00.
assumptions: No rounding or grace tolerance is authorized. For this benchmark the no-show threshold controls a rider_no_show fee; expiration of free wait alone is insufficient.
